column1: # quest_offer_reward_locale (RewardText -- reward-screen dialogue): CORRECTED 2026-07-12,
# re-checked against the current (368-entry, then 386-entry) skip list.
# 5 of the 6 remaining entries resolved 2026-07-12:
# 14418/14420 (The Deathstalkers): unreachable, identical content to reachable quest
# 1978 of the same title -- confirmed duplicate, moved to skip list.
# 25092 (Elemental Research): English source itself contains literal "[ph] log
# description" placeholder text (never finished by Blizzard) -- moved to skip list.
# 14488 (You've Been Served): TRANSLATED. Reachable via the "Love is in the Air"
# seasonal event (game_event 8). RewardText "What we do here is none of your
# business..." -> "我們在這裡做的事，不關你的事……" (Apothecary Hummel, no unique
# NPC/item names in this specific line).
# 24426/24427 (Call to Arms: Alterac Valley) still open: initially suspected as part
# of the same internal-stub family as skip-listed 24222/24227 (QuestLevel=-1), but
# that turned out to be wrong -- 4 sibling "Call to Arms" quests (11337/11341/14179/
# 14182) already have real, well-written base zhTW translations despite the same
# QuestLevel=-1/unreachable signature. This whole 32-quest family is a level-bracket
# variant matrix for the real BG-queue "Call to Arms" bonus-reward system, granted by
# hardcoded game logic rather than NPC/GO interaction -- our reachability check can't
# see that mechanism. Only quests whose title literally says "DEPRECATED" (24222,
# 24227) are confirmed dead. Do NOT skip-list 24426/24427 without individually
# verifying they're actually part of the dead pair, not just an untranslated (but
# real) bracket variant like most of their siblings.
